name: Mosyle
description: Apple Mobile Device Management (MDM) solution for managing iPads, iPhones, Macs, and Apple TVs in educational and enterprise environments.

config.setupInstructions:
Mosyle has two products with separate APIs; pick the one that matches your subscription:
 - Mosyle Business (Enterprise) — for businesses, uses businessapi.mosyle.com/v1
 - Mosyle Manager (Education)  — for schools, uses managerapi.mosyle.com/v2
Selecting the wrong environment will always fail — Mosyle treats them as separate APIs.

Steps:
1. Sign in to your Mosyle admin console (mybusiness.mosyle.com or myschool.mosyle.com).
2. Go to Organization → API Integration.
3. Enable the API Integration if it is not already enabled.
4. Generate a new Access Token (or copy an existing one).
5. Below, fill in: the Mosyle Environment that matches your product, the Access Token, and the Admin Email and Password of a Mosyle administrator user. Mosyle Business requires the admin email/password — the Access Token alone is not sufficient because Mosyle exchanges them for a session token on every connection.

Notes:
 - If you regenerate the Access Token, paste the new value here and re-run the check.
 - The Admin Email and Password are the same credentials you use to log into the Mosyle web console.

credentialFields.label: Mosyle Environment
credentialFields.helpText: Select your Mosyle product. Business = businessapi.mosyle.com/v1; Manager = managerapi.mosyle.com/v2.

credentialFields.label: Access Token
credentialFields.helpText: Generated in your Mosyle admin console: Organization → API Integration.

credentialFields.label: Admin Email
credentialFields.helpText: Email of a Mosyle administrator user. Mosyle Business exchanges this with your password (plus the Access Token) for a session token on every connection.

credentialFields.label: Admin Password
credentialFields.helpText: Password of the Mosyle administrator user above.
